title: Yeti
creator: CrossFit
description: 25 pull-ups, 10 muscle-ups, a 1.5-mile run, 10 muscle-ups and 25 pull-ups, for time. Honours U.S. Bureau of Land Management smokejumper Mark Thomas Urban, killed in a parachute jump during an equipment evaluation in Idaho in 2013. Fast if you have muscle-ups; scale them to chest-to-bar pull-ups and dips.
